subject: Re: Redwood discovery — next steps and pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlasops.com>; Sofia Ramos <s.ramos@atlasops.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood discovery — recap & next steps

Hi Liam / Sofia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really enjoyed diving into AtlasOps' ingestion pipeline and the low-latency monitoring use case. Quick recap from our side and the proposed next steps: 

What we heard:
- Ingest ~5k events/sec today, spikes up to 12k during peak maintenance windows.
- Primary goals: reduce per-request latency for anomaly detection pipelines, and reduce inference cost for historical batch jobs.
- Data residency / audit logs are required for regulatory reporting.

Redwood fit & proposal (high-level):
- Hosted API for rapid prototyping + Dedicated for production-critical pipelines to meet latency SLOs.
- Pre-built KV caching and batching strategy to cut token cost on streaming alerts.

Next steps we proposed:
1) I’ll send a one-pager + quickstart plan that maps to your ingestion profile (attached).
2) If it looks good, we schedule a 45-min technical workshop w/ your infra and data teams (suggested: Tue 6/23 or Wed 6/24).
3) Draft mutual action plan to align procurement and security checklist (I attached a starter MAP).

Attachments: Redwood-Quickstart-Plan.pdf (proposal), AtlasOps-MAP.xlsx (starter MAP)

Open items we need from you (if handy):
- A sense of target latency SLOs for the anomaly path (p95 target).
- Whether you're open to a short Dedicated pilot on a commit (billing) or need procurement-approved PO first.

I'll follow up with a calendar poll for the workshop. Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Liam / Sofia —

I haven't heard back on the proposal or timing, so wanted to close the loop. If AtlasOps is still interested, I’d love one of the following so we can keep the opportunity active:

A) Confirm the July pilot slot and preferred workshop attendees (infra + ML ops)
B) Share procurement timeline (PO expected in June/July or later)
C) Let me know if you'd like me to close the file for now — happy to reopen anytime.

If I don't hear back by next Wednesday (7/1), I'll close the file but will of course re-open if your priorities change.

Thanks for considering Redwood — appreciate the time you and your team spent on the discovery call.
